description: CrowdSec Windows Firewall remediation component that applies CrowdSec ban decisions to Windows Firewall.
notes: Review status: this is an MSI-based Windows service, not a portable application. The upstream WiX installer installs and registers a Windows service and runs a custom action to register the bouncer with an existing CrowdSec engine.

The bouncer requires the .NET 10 runtime. The MSI launch condition checks for this runtime; the upstream Chocolatey package installs it, but this manifest does not yet provide an equivalent Scoop dependency/install flow.

Do not use a plain Scoop MSI extraction as a substitute for installation: it would not execute the service-install and bouncer-registration custom actions. Scoop's legacy msi manifest property is deprecated, and the upstream WiX source generates the MSI ProductCode rather than declaring a stable ProductCode suitable for a verified manifest.
Keep under review until a supported install/uninstall strategy handles the .NET 10 dependency, Windows service lifecycle, bouncer registration, and upgrades.

Upstream issue #73, opened 2026-11-02, reports that a failed startup decision pull is not retried and can leave the firewall blocklist empty after reboot: https://github.com/crowdsecurity/cs-windows-firewall-bouncer/issues/73
